## Items (last 24h, verified)

1. **[TNSTC/MTC] Vettri Payanam statewide rollout** — CM Joseph Vijay launched the expanded free-travel scheme Oct 2 at Koyambedu: 12,692 of 18,413 STC buses (~69%) now zero-fare for women & transgender riders; ~84.32 lakh women expected daily; ~₹6,000 crore/year; ~85% of all daily trips (1.65L of 1.95L) covered; SETC excluded; Chengalpattu & Tiruppur deferred (Madurantakam/Dharapuram bypoll MCC).
   — The New Indian Express, Oct 2 — https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2026/Oct/02/cm-vijay-launches-expanded-vettri-payanam-scheme-84-lakh-women-to-benefit-daily (also The Hindu Oct 2 explainer: https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/what-is-the-vettri-payanam-thittam-launched-by-tamil-nadu-cm-vijay-explained/article71535917.ece)

2. **[TNSTC] Day-1 fare-collection complaints (accountability)** — Coimbatore women on route 70 (₹125, 5 riders) and Mettupalayam–Coimbatore passengers allege conductors collected fares hours after the Oct 2 launch; TNSTC blames conductor shift-end timing; corporation says erring staff will face action. No dedicated grievance channel yet.
   — The New Indian Express, Oct 3 — https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2026/Oct/03/female-passengers-allege-conductors-collected-fares-after-vettri-payanam-launch-2

3. **[CMRL] Three TBM breakthroughs in 3 days, Phase 2** — TBM Kaveri broke through at KMC Hospital station Sep 29; TBM Marutham at Villivakkam Bus Terminus (Corridor 5) Sep 30; TBM Adyar at RK Salai station Oct 1 after a 277-day drive with 11 cutterhead interventions.
   — LiveChennai, Oct 2 — https://www.livechennai.com/detailnews.asp?newsid=83496

4. **[CMRL] September ridership past 1 crore again** — 1,00,26,601 trips in Sept 2026 (4th month of 2026 above 1 crore: Mar, Jul, Aug, Sep); avg daily 3,34,220; single-day peak 3,93,580 on Sep 11.
   — LiveChennai, Oct 2 — https://www.livechennai.com/detailnews.asp?catid=&newsid=83499

5. **[CUMTA/CMRL] Chennai One uptake still small vs NCMC card** — Sept digital ticketing mix: Singara Chennai Card (NCMC) 51.95 lakh journeys; Chennai One app 3.12 lakh; ONDC 12.33 lakh; WhatsApp 4.34 lakh.
   — LiveChennai, Oct 2 — https://www.livechennai.com/detailnews.asp?catid=&newsid=83499

6. **[CMRL/State Highways] Teynampet–Saidapet flyover cleared above live metro tunnels** — 3.2-km, 4-lane, ₹621-crore Anna Salai elevated corridor; 2.4 km runs directly above Phase 1 tunnels/station boxes at Teynampet & Nandanam; 50 of 69 piers erected; portal frames planned above stations; country's first flyover directly over an operational metro tunnel; due March 2027.
   — The New Indian Express, Oct 3 — https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/chennai/2026/Oct/03/cmrl-gives-nod-to-corridor-above-teynampet-nandanam-stations

7. **Reported, unverified in print** — Phase 2 tunnelling now 48% (26.97 of 55.61 km planned underground; 11 of 23 TBMs finished, 8 active, 4 being readied) per CMRL-corridor trackers on X (@Srinivas_091294, @UpdatesChennai, Oct 3). Not found in a print publication within 24h; labelled "reported" in the thread.
